mechanism_narrative: A sustained 6-month decline in GDP growth (GDPC1) below 1.5% signals weakening aggregate demand, which historically leads to lower corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative GDP growth signal.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in the industrial production index (INDPRO) above 2% signals accelerated economic activity and higher corporate earnings, which historically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite positive industrial production signal.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 4.5% signals monetary tightening, which historically leads to higher discount rates and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite monetary tightening signal.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 6.5% signals labor market weakness, which historically leads to lower corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite rising unemployment signal.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1.2 million units signals weakening residential demand, which historically leads to lower corporate earnings in construction and related sectors and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite declining housing starts signal.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in real sales of domestic product (RSAFS) below $500 billion signals weakening aggregate demand, which historically leads to lower corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite declining real sales signal.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in GDP growth (GDPC1) below 1.5% combined with a 3-month rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 6.5% signals a dual weakness in both economic activity and labor market, which historically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite dual weakness in GDP growth and unemployment signal.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 4.5% combined with a 3-month decline in GDP growth (GDPC1) below 1.5% signals monetary tightening during economic weakness, which historically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite monetary tightening during economic weakness signal.
